headline: Denied zoning amendment at 1432 Main Street for Ferris Development; overrode mayor's vetoes of Orders #36946 and #36947.
summary: Overrode the mayor's vetoes of Orders #36946 and #36947. Denied a zoning amendment at 1432 Main Street and tabled special permit applications at 220 Moody St and 96 Tower Road. Approved a first reading of a compensation ordinance amendment for non-union employees.
decisions: Approved the minutes from 6/15/2026 by voice vote.
Approved the minutes from 6/22/2026 by voice vote.
Tabled the 220 Moody St special permit application by voice vote.
Referred the CAVA Group LLC special permit application at 96 Tower Road to the Law Department for review, 5-0 voice vote.
Referred information on the 96 Tower Road application to the petitioner and/or Law Department once redacted by the Clerk and Councillor Harris, by voice vote.
Tabled the CAVA Group LLC special permit application at 96 Tower Road by voice vote.
Approved the withdrawal without prejudice of the zoning amendment at 181-185 Felton Street by voice vote.
Approved overriding the mayor's veto of Order #36946 by voice vote.
Approved overriding the mayor's veto of Order #36947 by voice vote.
Denied the zoning amendment at 1432 Main Street for Ferris Development by voice vote.
Approved a first reading of the compensation ordinance amendment pay chart for non-union employees by voice vote.

plain_text:
Ordinances & Rules Committee
Meeting Minutes
August 3, 2026
The Chair called the meeting to order at 9:57 p.m.
Present: Councillors Dunn, Harris, Logan, Hanley & McLaughlin.
Absent: None.
Councillor Dunn moved approval of the minutes from 6/15/2026. The motion was approved by a 
voice vote.
Councillor Dunn moved approval of the minutes from 6/22/2026. The motion was approved by a 
voice vote.
Charlie Johnson, of The Waltham Times, was audio recording the meeting.
First agenda item: 220 Moody St Special Pemrit Application
Attorney Phil McCourt, representing the petitioner, was present and spoke on the application and 
gave an update on the construction of the lot(s), and preparing a financial statement for the 
easements. The next public hearing will be heard on October 26, 2026. President Logan moved to 
table the application. The motion was approved by a voice vote.
Second agenda item: CAVA Group LLC for Special Permit Application at 96 Tower Road
Attorney Micheal Connors, representing the petitioner spoke on the application. Councillor Logan
moved to send the application to the Law Department for review. The motion was approved by a 
voice vote. Councillor Logan moved to send any information to the petitioner and/or Law 
Department once redacted by Clerk and Councillor Harris. The motion was approved by a voice 
vote. The next public hearing will be heard on October 13, 2026. President Logan moved to table 
the application. The motion was approved by a voice vote.
President Logan moved to take the Zoning Amendment at 181-185 Felton Street off the table. The
motion was approved by a voice vote. The petitioner submitted a leave to withdraw letter without 
prejudice to Committee. The time frame of 90 days will be running out before next meeting. 
President Logan moved approval of the withdrawal without prejudice. The motion was approved 
by a voice vote.
Councillor Logan spoke on the statement of objection for Orders #36946 and Order #36947 from 
the mayor. President Logan moved to override the mayors veto on the Order # 36946.  On the 
motion Councillor Hanley spoke. The motion was approved by a voice vote. President Logan 
moved to override the mayors veto on the Order # 36947.  The motion was approved by a voice 
vote.
Councillor Logan moved to take the zoning amendment at 1432 Main Street for Ferris 
Development off the table. The motion was approved on voice vote. President Logan moved to 
deny the zoning amendment, and he read a statement about his reasoning for the denial. 
The motion was approved by a voice vote.
President Logan spoke on the compensation ordinance amendment pay chart for the non-union 
employees. He moved approval for a first reading of the amendment. The motion was approved 
by a voice vote.
Councillor Logan moved to adjourn. The motion was approved by a voice vote and Chairwoman 
Harris declared the meeting adjourned at 11:55 p.m.
Respectfully submitted,
Kara Wilson, Clerk of the Ordinances & Rules Committee
August 18, 2026
